message: Vector Rebel v3.2.5 is the current managed release.
releaseNotes: Adds automatic per-installation usage telemetry keyed to the configured My Tour PPE profile name; reports installed version, liveness, My Tour PPE / After-Fire / Captain Monthly / Daily Captain Check usage, and sanitized program errors without intentionally transmitting gear details, signatures, notes, asset IDs, or individual PASS/FAIL answers. Managed Tampermonkey update URLs are restored.
